liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sunrise** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Sunrise was left off Dick's Picks because the performance was terrible; Reviewer defends this version of Sunrise as awesome, despite Donna's frequent weak spots [13][19]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Fall tour had hinted at it; Candace said between sets it had been played at the soundcheck [9]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Reviewer says Donna Jean's overpowering wail here turns some listeners off [14]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 other source): Played as a second encore, after Terrapin Station [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd77-12-29 t01 Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd77-12-29 t02 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd77-12-29 t03 They Love Each Other**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd77-12-29 t04 Mama Tried**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd77-12-29 t05 Loser**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd77-12-29 t06 Looks Like Rain**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd77-12-29 t07 Tennessee Jed**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd77-12-29 t08 New Minglewood Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-12-29.141740.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 191 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1977-12-29.holwein.audience.jfishman.108432.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience recording plays back at too fast a pitch and needs speed correction, but is otherwise decent; Recording is not stellar but adequately conveys how the night sounded [15][20]
- **gd1977-12-29.137198.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 14 songs; 98 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [6]
- **gd1977-12-29.aud.92374.flac16**: audience recording; 9 songs; 68 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [7]. Said about its sound: Sounds punchy and quite good for a many-generation cassette [11]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended and calls it the greatest show they have ever seen in person [20]
- Reviewer judges this old audience tape far better than the Dick's Picks release [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-12-29.141740.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Analog Soundboard > Cassette > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav… [1]
- **gd1977-12-29.holwein.audience.jfishman.108432.flac16**: taped by Reinhart Holwein; transferred by JR Fishman; source: Reinhardt Holwein Audience Reel > ???? > DAT > CDR > EAC Secure Mode > WAV > FLAC [5]
- **gd1977-12-29.137198.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat (48k) [6]. Also: Complete second set taken from the vault master reels; date appears on Dick's Picks 10 [6]
- **gd1977-12-29.aud.92374.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by unknown; source: n-th gen maxell cassette-> sb audigy-> audacity-> cd wav-> flac [7]. Also: Audience recording circulating as a distant-generation cassette copy; Audience taper is unknown [11][17]
